category.name: Password managers
category.description: Store, share and administer business credentials.
category.audience: Employees and organizations using online accounts
category.audienceRationale: Credentials and controlled sharing apply across industries and company sizes; qualitative reach, not a market-size estimate.

pricing.note: Business plan, USD 8.99 per user/month annually. Teams Starter has a lower ten-user minimum package; not a single-seat entry price.

oss.name: Vaultwarden
oss.classificationReason: AGPL server has no commercial edition gate in official feature documentation; broad vault/sharing functionality included. Unofficial Bitwarden-compatible server, not a full Bitwarden enterprise implementation.

health.rsx: Overall score 5.0/10. Activity 6.1, maintenance 10.0, security 0.0, and license 5.0 are the main decision signals.

serviceLimitations: Official Bitwarden clients and external push services retain their own terms and availability; no official Bitwarden support for this server.
Missing or partial upstream features are implementation gaps, not paid unlocks; custom roles and public API coverage require review.

oss.name: Passbolt Community Edition
locked: SSO, LDAP provisioning, account recovery and audit logs require Pro
oss.classificationReason: CE is AGPL and unlimited-user. Tags affect routine organization, giving C under this rubric. Pro is also AGPL; paid distribution and subscription-key requirements must not be described as proprietary-code gates.

health.rsx: Overall score 6.0/10. Activity 2.3, maintenance 9.0, security 5.4, and license 5.0 are the main decision signals.

serviceLimitations: Pro subscription governs updates/support and supplied license keys; vendor describes Pro source as AGPL.

oss.name: Bitwarden
oss.license: AGPL-3.0-only AND LicenseRef-Bitwarden-1.0 (mixed repository; AGPL core)
locked: Integrated TOTP authenticator and file attachments require Premium entitlements
Business event logs, directory provisioning, SSO and enterprise policies require paid organization plans
oss.classificationReason: AGPL core is OSI licensed; /bitwarden_license is separately Bitwarden-licensed. Paid entitlements include ordinary vault functions, so mixed repository must not be presented as entirely AGPL.

health.rsx: Overall score 6.5/10. Activity 6.5, maintenance 10.0, security 5.4, and license 3.0 are the main decision signals.

serviceLimitations: Official hosted service plan limits and storage quotas are distinct from the AGPL core license.

alternatives.migrationNotes: Official 1Password import documented. Review shared-vault permissions, attachments, passkeys and paid organization requirements before replacing business administration.
Use Bitwarden-compatible clients with this unofficial server. Verify import and administration requirements on a test instance; upstream API and client compatibility may vary.
Team password sharing and browser workflows overlap; rebuild access groups and evaluate CE versus Pro needs. Direct 1Password import parity was not established.

uncertainties: Vaultwarden has no first-party hosted offering identified in reviewed project documentation; third-party hosts were not evaluated.
Bitwarden separately licensed directory identified by pinned root LICENSE; fetching the separate license body failed via web and sandbox network. OSI=true refers only to AGPL core.
Passbolt edition gates are paid availability restrictions, not claims that Pro is non-OSI.
No migration tests performed; capability mapping is documentary.
